summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K attaching its October 12, 2026 press release detailing daily share repurchases from October 5-9, 2026, under a SEK 15 billion buyback announced April 16, 2026 and running through March 31, 2027. The company repurchased 7,917,288 Class B shares at a weighted average of SEK 94.2688, totaling SEK 746,353,207.57, executed on Nasdaq Stockholm by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE under MAR safe-harbour rules. Treasury stock reached 125,805,951 Class B shares. The board intends to propose cancelling repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM. Watch for ongoing execution pace and any cancellation proposal.
